# Logos

Shown only to say which technology a step runs on ("powered by"), never as Trial Autopsy's own branding.
Files are the companies' published artwork, unmodified; the `-mark` files are the same artwork with the
view box cropped to the symbol.

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `nvidia.svg`, `nvidia-mark.svg` | NVIDIA badge logo, Wikimedia Commons `File:NVIDIA_logo.svg` |
| `claude.svg` | Claude symbol (Anthropic), Wikimedia Commons `File:Claude_AI_symbol.svg` |
| `zetaris.svg`, `zetaris-mark.svg` | zetaris.com, `zetaris-logo-indigo.svg` |
| `meterless.svg` | meterless.ai, `meterless-icon.svg` |
| `cursor.svg` | Cursor app icon (Anysphere, Inc.), converted from PDF to SVG unchanged |

NVIDIA and Nemotron are trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation. Claude and Anthropic are trademarks of Anthropic, PBC.
Cursor is a trademark of Anysphere, Inc. Zetaris and Meterless are trademarks of their respective owners.
